project: Kiln heat-recovery system and variable frequency drives

derived_metrics.note: Estimates use an illustrative factor. A change in electricity use alone does not prove a change in emissions: energy source, boundary and production mix can differ.

expected_outcome: Emissions claim (8% absolute reduction) has a stated baseline year, a stated method and a consistent calculation; electricity records (-8.0%) and production records (+3.0%) agree. Practice claims reference appendix items. Claims should be marked supported.
